rationale: The m-prefixed participle mnaqšo belongs to Stem II mnaqašle/mnaqəš. The Stem I participles in this entry are nqišo and nqiše, whereas Stem II already has the matching mnaqašto (116/21) and mnaqše (11/18). Move this example to the existing Stem II Part. Pass. box.

summary: Translate naqšat ʕatiqe as old paintings.
rationale: The Turoyo phrase is ban naqšat ʕatiqe, with the adjective ʕatiqe “old”. The second all in the English sentence does not translate that adjective and is an evident slip for old. The supplied batch also illustrates the same adjective in 1/16: u bayto ʕatiqo we, translated war das Haus alt.
